prompt:
Extract every named company from the news paragraph in the user message. The paragraph may be in English, Swedish or German; apply the same rules in all three languages.

Return exactly one bare JSON array of strings, with no Markdown, wrapper, comments or prose. If no company is named, return [].

Include every named business, even if mentioned only through a product or service, a possessive, a website or an email domain. Exclude people and titles, cities, regions, countries, product categories, generic descriptions and unnamed businesses. Do not invent names or infer ownership from outside knowledge.

Strip a trailing legal form: AB, GmbH, AG, Ltd, PLC, Inc., LLC, Corp., AS, ASA, Oy, Oyj, A/S, ApS, SA, SAS, B.V., N.V., with or without a final period. Keep words that belong to the name, including Group, Systems, Labs, Partners, Works, Freight, Energy and Foods.

When a product or service name is built from a company name plus a product word, return only the company name, even when it never appears alone. Several products of the same company yield one entry. Remove English possessive endings with straight or curly apostrophes and Swedish or German genitive -s when it marks possession.

A website or email domain counts as a mention of its owner. If the owner's name appears elsewhere in the paragraph, use that spelling. Otherwise take the domain label before the top-level domain and capitalise its first letter, ignoring the www prefix and any email local part. Never return the address itself.

Preserve the source spelling, capitalisation and diacritics; never translate, abbreviate or ASCII-fold names. Deduplicate across all mention forms. List companies in order of their first mention in any form. Before answering, scan the entire paragraph for all mention forms.

Text: "At a freight depot, Qävrun Systems GmbH trialled Œlvethi Hub while packing crews compared Mörravex's dispatch schedule with updates from press@zunqareth.example. Qävrun Systems later confirmed that the trial would continue."
Output: ["Qävrun Systems","Œlvethi","Mörravex","Zunqareth"]
